title: Dog Care & Budget Calculator: real ownership costs
subtitle: Monthly, annual, and one-time breakdown plus a short readiness quiz and recommended budget.
seoTitle: Dog Ownership Cost Calculator | Budget & Readiness | DailyLogic
seoDescription: Free dog care budget calculator by size, age, and lifestyle. Food, vet, grooming, training breakdown plus readiness quiz and yearly forecast — in your browser.
heroDescription: A dog is love — and a budget. Get an honest estimate of recurring, annual, and one-time costs, then check whether your home is ready on time and emergency cushion.

sections.heading: What this calculator does
paragraphs: You set size, age, alone time, grooming, and training — then get a realistic cost breakdown.
A short readiness quiz checks time, budget, space, and commitment.
The report shows a recommended monthly budget, yearly forecast, insights, and smart savings tips.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Fill the setup, review costs, then answer 10 readiness questions.
Save to history (Expand on the home page) or download a result card.
Treat the estimate as planning guidance — not a formal quote.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Most expensive surprises come from vet care and alone-time coverage — not food.
Size and age tuning prevents wrong estimates that lead to unready adoptions.
A small monthly emergency cushion protects pets and finances.

faq.question: Are amounts exact for my area?
faq.answer: They’re educational mid-market estimates. Check local vet and supplier prices.

faq.question: Do I have to adopt after calculating?
faq.answer: No. The goal is honest prep — sometimes the answer is wait.

faq.question: Is data stored on a server?
faq.answer: No. Everything runs and saves locally in the browser.
